dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No. If you ask me, it's a terrible day.

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: Don't be like that! The day isn't over yet. Do something that makes you happy. Then you can welcome tomorrow with a smile on your face.

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: A happy end to today means a happy start to tomorrow. Isn't that great!
